notes.title: Version 1.0.1 - Fixing small visual issues and stage 51
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Just released a patch to fix a few things:
[list]
[*]If a person kissed when blinking, they'd open their eyes after kiss and it'd look weird
[*]In stage 51 if you opened a door and got hit by Imp at the same time, the door would bug (not be able to move)
[/list]

That's it, just a couple simple fixes. Hope you guys are liking the game! :D
